transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well... I suppose I'm just having some trouble keeping up when people talk to me. Like, down at the museum, folks will be talking right to me about the next art walk or something, and I’m looking right at them, but... then I realize I missed the middle of what they said. I end up having to ask them to run it by me again. So... yeah. That's mainly why I'm here.
When this happens, can you hear the sound of their voice clearly, or does it sound muffled or hard to hear physically?
No, I... I hear them just fine. It doesn't sound muffled or anything like that.
About how long have you been noticing this trouble keeping up with conversations?

I suppose... maybe two years and four months, roughly. That's when I ended up taking over the museum liaison duties by myself. My friend... well, he passed away around then. So it's just been me doing it. It's been more noticeable since then, I guess.
Over the past two years, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or low in spirits?
No... not really. I mean, obviously it was hard when my friend passed, but... I wouldn't say I've been down all the time. I'm fine in that department. Just... regular, I guess.
Looking back to when you were a child or teenager in school, did you ever have trouble with focus or paying attention back then?

I suppose so... yes. Back in grade school, my report cards usually said things like... "daydreams" or "needs reminders to finish work." And... well, my mother used to have to sit right beside me just to keep me on track with my homework. At least until I was twelve or so. So... yeah. I guess I did.
Between your teenage years and two years ago, did you continue to have trouble with your attention or staying organized?
I don't really remember. It's been a long time since then. I suppose I just... got by. I didn't really think about it much.
Have you had any head injuries, concussions, or serious medical illnesses?
No... I haven't. No head injuries or anything like that. I've been healthy enough.
Outside of conversations, do you have trouble organizing your daily tasks, managing paperwork, or keeping track of deadlines?
Not really. I don't have many deadlines anymore, anyway. Just the usual bills and such... and I manage them fine, I suppose. It hasn't been a problem.
Do you often find your attention pulled away by unrelated thoughts or things happening around you when you are trying to focus?
No... I don't think so. It's usually pretty quiet around me anyway, so there isn't much to pull my attention away. I just do what I'm doing.
Do you find it difficult to keep your focus when reading books, articles, or longer documents?

Sometimes, I guess. If I sit down with... maybe a gallery packet or a set of notes, I start out fine. But after a few minutes, I'll realize my eyes are just moving over the page, and my mind has sort of wandered off. I just end up having to read the same part again. But that's about it.
